options.name: Dual judicial system
options.desc: There exists a secular and a religious branch of the country's judiciary. The two branches often suffer from subject matter jurisdiction disputes, leading to lengthy proceedings.

options.name: Justice system reform
options.desc: Due to clearly defined subject matter jurisdiction and a clause of lingering jurisdiction competence, the disputes between the branches of the judiciary have been greatly reduced.

options.name: Religious jurisdiction separation
options.desc: The religious part of the country's judiciary has been separated from the state and now functions as an intra-church institution.
